substantive_reconstruction.finite_and_compact_complements: For finite groups over F with |G| invertible, averaging conjugates of a projection onto W yields a G-equivariant projection fixing W, hence its kernel complements W. Characteristic p for C_p is genuinely excluded: on F_p², J=I+E12 has J^p=I and fixes Fe1, but every lift of e2 is moved by e1, ruling out an invariant complement. For continuous finite-dimensional real/complex actions of compact Hausdorff G, the averaged positive inner product is finite and invariant. Positivity uses continuity near identity and positive Haar mass of a nonempty open set; finite translates cover G, proving that mass cannot vanish. W-perp is invariant using inverses, so finite-dimensional induction gives complete reducibility, including the zero empty sum.
substantive_reconstruction.continuity_and_dimension: The abstract circle counterexample is legitimate, not a discontinuous formula accidentally claimed continuous: a Q-linear Hamel functional f with f(1)=0,f(alpha)=1 for irrational alpha descends to R/Z and yields a shear with invariant Ce1 and no complement. It exposes the missing continuity regime. In a strongly continuous unitary Hilbert action only CLOSED invariant subspaces automatically have orthogonal complements. Algebraic irreducibility and topological irreducibility are not conflated. Finite-group algebraic irreducibles have dimension at most |G| by the orbit span of any nonzero vector, even in modular characteristic. Compact strongly continuous unitary irreducibles being finite-dimensional, and their Hilbert decomposition, are instead correctly marked external Peter-Weyl consequences, not proved by the finite averaging argument.

Kernel/image Schur gives zero for inequivalent actions; in one chosen irrep, complex eigenvalue Schur and trace give (tr X/d)I. Matrix units yield integral conjugate(rho_ij) sigma_kl =delta_rho,sigma delta_i,k delta_j,l/d_rho. Thus sqrt(d_rho)rho_ij, NOT the raw coefficients, have unit norm. Characters already satisfy unit orthogonality after diagonal summation. Under L_h f(g)=f(h^-1 g), define f_i,j(g)=sqrt(d) conjugate(rho_ij(g)). Unitarity gives L_h f_i,j=sum_k rho_ki(h)f_k,j. Consequently the i-index carries rho and the fixed j-index supplies d copies. substantive_reconstruction.cardinal_and_field_boundaries: For infinite compact Hausdorff G, arbitrarily many disjoint nonempty open sets with positive Haar mass give arbitrarily many nonzero orthogonal indicators, so L²(G) is infinite-dimensional. For the circle, continuous characters are z^n: a local logarithm and continuity solve the local additive equation, and periodicity forces an integer frequency. Hence the Hilbert basis is countable although the abelian group's singleton conjugacy classes have continuum cardinality. Finite-complex regular-character multiplicities d give sum d²=|G|; this finite numerical identity does not become an untyped infinite-cardinal or Hamel-dimensional formula.
